verdict.rationale: Firecrawl's GitHub README directly states the story's capability: "Crawl an entire website and get content from all pages". The Spanish docs say the same, describing recursive crawling that returns content from every page. The webhooks docs confirm that crawl runs as a job you can track to completion without polling, which supports the one-request workflow. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of whole-site crawls, and documentation of crawl limits, depth controls and how results are returned at scale.
